about: What each provider's own page printed on the date above, copied by hand (never from a third party's table). The unit tests hold the catalogs against it: prices.test.ts. Update this file only after reading the page again, and change the date. status: verified = printed on the provider's page; derived = computed from a printed token price and formula (the page prints a rate or an example for one resolution only); unverified = the page does not say, or refuses.

creditUsd.source: https://kie.ai/pricing: «Pay as you go with credits (1 credit ≈ $0.005)»; «Larger top-ups include bonus credits; for example, a $1,250 top-up adds 10%»; a model page: «High-tier top-ups (+10% bonus) bring effective pricing down to ~$0.072 per second for 720p» (Wan 2.7 at 16 credits)
creditUsd.note: List rate. The rate does depend on the amount topped up (a bonus on large top-ups, ≈ $0.0045 a credit at $1,250); the other packages are behind kie's login (kie.ai/billing), unverified. The app prices at the list rate.
